lines.t: Yeah... I been quiet for a minute...
Whole time, He been callin’ my name.
Today the move... yeah...
He said, when you really decide, I’ma finish it,
Told me stop talkin’ ‘bout tomorrow, start livin’ it.
This ain’t no rehearsal, this the moment I’m in it,
Faith ain’t restin’, it’s work — gotta witness it.
Said if you ready to ride, then let go your life,
Ain’t no switchin’ sides when you walk in the light.
Gotta grind through the storm, keep the cross in sight,
I was built for the pressure, now the call feel right.
He said, “Today is the day, make your choice, don’t wait.”
Ain’t no safe play in the war for faith.
If I give up my life, then I’m walkin’ in grace,
Yeah, I’m all in — I can’t halfway pray.
Pressure moldin’ diamonds, yeah, the pain got worth,
Had to die to myself just to see rebirth.
You can’t run from the fire if you made for the dirt,
Every loss I took — man, it came with a word.
He said, “How I send you if you scared of the step?”
You can’t lead no man if your soul unfed.
Every test, every tear, put the fear to bed,
When I wake in the truth, that’s the life He said.
He said, “Today is the day, make your choice, don’t wait.”
Ain’t no safe play in the war for faith.
If I give up my life, then I’m walkin’ in grace,
Yeah, I’m all in — I can’t halfway pray.
Had to lose that pride, get clean, get wise,
Had to learn real power ain’t money or ties.
It’s peace in the fight, it’s love through the fire,
He said overcome, now my goals get higher.
Yeah... ain’t no delay, no disguise,
He said pick today — so I rise.
For the call and the cause, yeah, I decide.
One step, one truth — that’s my life.
"I told Him — if it’s time, I’m ready.
Ain’t no later, ain’t no maybe.
We walk now… with the cross on our back and peace in our chest.
Yeah... today I decide."
Yeah... today I decide."
